name: research-superpowers
description: Skill-driven research workflow for Claude Code and Cowork: idea → literature → ingest → analysis → draft → peer-review → publication. Methodology-aware (hermeneutic / quantitative / mixed). Focus-driven ingest: source pages capture project-specific extraction (claims relevant to a research focus), not generic summaries. MCP-aware: optional dao-paper-search-mcp + dao-searxng-mcp integration for verified citations and source-class detection. Click-friendly install via the scaffold-research-project skill — no terminal required. Built for theology, biblical archaeology, and digital humanities.
